You must not use LUVZY to harass, threaten, stalk, exploit, deceive or discriminate against anyone; promote violence or illegal activity; distribute intimate content without permission; or pressure another person for money, sexual activity or personal information.
Do not use the Service to facilitate trafficking, coercion, scams, impersonation, or the sale of prohibited goods or services. Follow the Community Guidelines and all laws that apply to your use.

sections.title: Messages, interests and interactions
paragraphs: Messages, interests, replies and other interactions must be lawful and respectful. Do not send unsolicited sexual material, dangerous links, fraudulent payment requests or communications designed to pressure another member.
The receiving member may save, screenshot or share what they see. Do not assume a message is fully private after delivery. We may restrict interaction patterns to prevent abuse or protect users.

paragraphs: Video features require a compatible device, an internet connection and permissions such as camera and microphone access. Each participant may refuse or end a call at any time. Do not record, stream, capture or redistribute another member's call or images without all consents and permissions required by law.

Where a call consumes Coins, the price or charge rate, expected use, charging start/stop rules and low-balance behavior must be disclosed in the call interface before charges apply. A call may end automatically when the available balance is insufficient, as displayed in the product.

Call availability and audio/video quality depend on technical and network conditions. We do not guarantee uninterrupted communications. Actual platform recording practices, if any, must be described in the Privacy Policy and appropriate in-product notices.

sections.title: Reports, blocking and moderation
paragraphs: You can use available in-product tools to block users and report content or conduct that may violate these Terms or create a safety concern. Include enough detail for us to understand the issue, but do not submit another person’s sensitive information unless it is needed for the report.

We may review reports, preserve relevant information when legally permitted, remove content, restrict features, suspend accounts or take other proportionate action. We may consider context, severity, history, reliability and safety. We do not guarantee that every report will result in a particular outcome or response time.

Where available and required by law, we will provide a way to appeal certain moderation decisions. Nothing in this section prevents you from contacting emergency services when someone faces immediate danger.

sections.title: Offline meetings and personal safety
paragraphs: You are responsible for your choices when communicating or meeting with another user. Protect your home address, financial details, identity documents and other sensitive information. Consider meeting in a public place, arranging your own transport and telling someone you trust about your plans.

LUVZY does not conduct background checks unless we expressly say otherwise, and a profile or platform verification indicator is not a guarantee of identity, character or safety. Use your judgment and stop contact if you feel unsafe.
